record.detail: The Immigration Agency said 78 foreign nationals (53 Chinese, 11 Russian and others) were deported for visa or residence overstays, unauthorised work and other violations, with 3-5 year re-entry bans; it reported 1,222 deportations in the previous year.

record.title: Drug crimes up 21.6% in 2025, 417 arrested
record.detail: The General Prosecutor's Office said 551 drug-related crimes were registered in 2025, up 21.6% on 2024, and 417 people were apprehended, over 40% aged 25-35.
record.attribution: State General Prosecutor's Office via Xinhua

record.title: Ulaanbaatar AQI 204, world's most polluted major city
record.detail: IQAir ranked Ulaanbaatar the most polluted major city globally with a US AQI of 204 (very unhealthy), driven largely by coal heating and winter inversions; improvement to moderate was forecast.

record.title: Dzud kills 26,300+ livestock in January
record.detail: The National Statistics Office said more than 26,300 head of livestock died in January, with heavy losses in Uvs, Bayan-Ulgii, Zavkhan and Uvurkhangai; at least 11 of 21 provinces were under dzud conditions.

record.title: All road crossings with China closed for Tsagaan Sar
record.detail: Customs said all 10 road crossings with China, including Zamiin-Uud and Gashuunsukhait, would close 17-20 February and some Russian crossings 18-20 February, while Zamyn-Uud rail traffic and Altanbulag continued operating.

record.title: Van falls through ice on Khuvsgul Lake, two dead
record.detail: A UAZ-452 van carrying seven people plunged through an ice crack in the Khachim area of Dalai Zakh on Khuvsgul Lake; one adult and one child died and five were rescued, and officials warned against driving on frozen lakes.

record.title: Winter storm: 31 m/s winds, -48C, 5 dead
record.detail: A severe winter storm on 21-24 Feb brought heavy snow, winds up to 31 m/s and temperatures as low as -48C; 5 deaths and 56 injuries were recorded, per the IFRC DREF operation MDRMN021 cited by Wikipedia.
record.attribution: IFRC DREF report as summarised by Wikipedia

record.title: Khovd resident charged over transporting endangered Altai snowcock
record.detail: Environmental police charged a Khovd resident under the wildlife-trafficking article of the Criminal Code for unlawfully transporting Altai snowcock in January; the case went to prosecutors and the suspect paid 434,000 MNT in compensation.
record.attribution: Police / Environmental Police Department, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Severe sludge pollution of Tuul River below UB treatment plant
record.detail: Sludge deposits 20-50 cm thick were found along about 21 km of the Tuul River downstream of Ulaanbaatar's Central Wastewater Treatment Plant (built 1964, not modernised), per city officials; a new plant was due in May 2026.
record.attribution: Deputy Governor of Ulaanbaatar via Montsame

record.title: 14 forest and steppe fires burn 21,175 ha so far in 2026
record.detail: NEMA said 14 forest and steppe fires had been recorded since the start of the year, mainly in eastern Dornod, Sukhbaatar and Khentii provinces, affecting 21,175 hectares, with human negligence the main cause.
record.attribution: National Emergency Management Agency via Xinhua

record.title: Court confiscates official's unexplained 45m MNT vehicle
record.detail: The IAAC said a first-instance court ordered MNT 45,000,000, the value of a Lexus RX-450 held by an unnamed public official who could not explain its lawful source, transferred to the state budget under an unexplained-wealth mechanism of the Anti-Corruption Law.

record.title: Wildfire warning as over half of provinces extremely dry
record.detail: The national meteorological agency warned of heightened wildfire risk with more than half of the 21 provinces in extremely dry conditions; three wildfires were being fought in Dornod and Khentii.
record.agency: National Agency for Meteorology and Environmental Monitoring
record.attribution: National Agency for Meteorology and Environmental Monitoring via Xinhua

record.title: Telecom firm cites 694bn MNT online-fraud losses in 2025
record.detail: In a press release launching an anti-fraud awareness campaign, Unitel Group said online fraud cost Mongolians 694 billion MNT in 2025, that fraud cases rose 296% over five years and that digital crimes exceeded 30% of recorded crimes; the release does not cite an official source for these figures.
record.attribution: Figures claimed by Unitel Group (private telecom operator), unsourced

record.title: 48 forest and steppe fires, 229,006 ha burned by mid-April
record.detail: As of 12 April, 48 fires had hit 32 soums in eight provinces and two capital districts, affecting about 229,006 ha (704 ha forest); 8 people from 3 households and some 2,000 livestock were moved, and over 1,650 personnel with 264 vehicles were deployed, per the report.
record.attribution: National Emergency Management Agency figures, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: 48 e-scooter and moped accidents in four days after road authorisation
record.detail: The National Traumatology and Orthopedics Research Center recorded 48 accidents involving scooters, mopeds and similar vehicles on 10-14 April after they were authorised on roads, with 87.5% of injured not wearing helmets; it logged 2,792 such injuries in 2025.
record.agency: National Traumatology and Orthopedics Research Center
record.attribution: National Traumatology and Orthopedics Research Center

record.title: Grassfires in Zavkhan and Khentii extinguished
record.detail: A grassfire in Otgon soum, Zavkhan, started on 21 April and was out by the next morning, and another in Delgerkhaan soum, Khentii, on 22 April was contained within 37 minutes; NEMA warned dry conditions persist.
record.attribution: National Emergency Management Agency, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Low rainfall, heat forecast for eastern region May-July
record.detail: The Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences forecast low precipitation and above-average temperatures in June-July in the eastern region, 50-70 mm+ rain in the central zone and above-average June rain in the west.
record.agency: Institute of Plant and Agricultural Sciences

record.title: Cabinet suspends Tuul Expressway project
record.detail: The government halted the Tuul Highway project after 300+ petitions, pending a law-enforcement and oversight review of officials linked to it, according to the Cabinet Secretariat.

record.title: IAAC says USD 13.9m in stolen assets recovered since 2017
record.detail: IAAC chief commissioner Z.Baasannyam said the agency has recovered USD 13.9 million in stolen assets through international cooperation since 2017, citing a case of GBP 1.18 million in bribes laundered via Latvian and BVI accounts into a London flat, and MNT 11.3 billion (USD 5.7 million) recovered from the Isle of Man.
record.attribution: Claim by IAAC chief commissioner (interview with Udriin Sonin)

record.title: Customs inspector held in bribery and money-laundering probe
record.detail: The IAAC arrested a state customs inspector accused of taking a 50 million MNT bribe from the director of a freight-forwarding company, who was also detained; the case is opened under money laundering, abuse of power and bribe-taking articles of the Criminal Code, per the report.
record.attribution: Independent Authority Against Corruption, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: M5.5 quake and aftershocks strike Zereg soum, Khovd
record.detail: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake (GFZ reported 5.9) struck about 26 km southeast of Zereg soum centre, followed by M4.2 and M3.9 tremors; it was felt in 15 soums with no damage or casualties reported, per the Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics.
record.attribution: Institute of Astronomy and Geophysics, Mongolian Academy of Sciences; GFZ epicentre

record.title: 2,340 foreigners involved in visa violations in four months
record.detail: Authorities processed 994 immigration violations involving 2,340 foreign nationals from 34 countries in January-April, 64% of them Chinese, mostly residence-permit and overstay cases.
record.agency: Department of Foreign Citizens and Nationality
record.attribution: Department of Foreign Citizens and Nationality

record.title: Girl, 3, dies after falling into abandoned mining borehole
record.detail: A three-year-old girl fell into an abandoned 30 m deep, 30 cm wide mining borehole in Zaamar soum; more than 100 rescuers worked 58 hours and recovered her body on 30 May, NEMA said. The incident prompted a nationwide hazard inspection.
record.attribution: National Emergency Management Agency via Xinhua

record.title: FMD confirmed in Bulgan soum, Khovd
record.detail: The Khovd governor's office confirmed foot-and-mouth disease in 35 cattle of seven herder households; about 5,500 livestock in the zone were at risk and quarantine was imposed.

record.title: IAAC, US officials discuss crypto tracing and asset recovery
record.detail: IAAC leadership met the US Embassy legal attache and an IRS Criminal Investigation official to discuss asset recovery in money-laundering and corruption cases, cryptocurrency investigation and asset-freezing techniques, and cybercrime cooperation.

record.title: Fraud now about half of reported crimes in Ulaanbaatar
record.detail: The head of the Capital City Police Department told a meeting with the city council chairman that fraud (online shopping scams, phishing for bank details, fake lottery and giveaway schemes) has risen sharply and now makes up about half of reported crimes in the city; no case counts or loss figures were given.
record.attribution: Claim by Capital City Police Department head

record.title: FMD outbreak in Dundgovi (Gurvansaikhan, Adaatsag)
record.detail: Dundgovi's governor's office reported FMD in Gurvansaikhan and Adaatsag soums, with quarantine, disinfection and vaccination under way; outbreaks also reported in Khovd and Bayan-Ulgii.

record.title: SAT-1 FMD strain detected for first time; Khovd on alert
record.detail: The Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry said the highly virulent SAT-1 strain was identified in Mongolia for the first time; Khovd imposed indefinite heightened preparedness and banned large gatherings.
record.agency: Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry

record.title: 1,230+ animals culled over FMD in west
record.detail: More than 1,230 livestock were culled in Bayan-Ulgii and Khovd over SAT-1 FMD, and serotype O was reported in six of 21 provinces, according to the General Authority for Veterinary Services.

record.title: Smuggled Tarbosaurus skeleton returned from France
record.detail: A Tarbosaurus bataar skeleton and other fossils in 15 crates, illegally excavated in Umnugovi and smuggled out around 2006 with forged documents per police, were handed back after 13 years in French custody.
record.agency: Prosecutor General's Office; General Police Department; General Customs Administration

record.title: OSCE flags Mongolian victims of trafficking into cyber-scam operations
record.detail: During a follow-up visit to Mongolia, the OSCE Special Representative on trafficking held a workshop on trafficking for forced criminality in cyber-scam operations, citing OSCE research with documented cases involving Mongolian victims; no victim numbers were published.
record.attribution: OSCE Special Representative for Combating Trafficking in Human Beings

record.title: Child-safety campaign finds nearly 15,000 hazards
record.detail: Following the Zaamar borehole death, inspections of 7,844 sites between 30 May and 15 June found 14,977 safety violations, of which 11,999 were fixed, according to the Authority of Child and Family Development Protection.
record.agency: Authority of Child and Family Development Protection
record.attribution: Authority of Child and Family Development Protection, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Protesters briefly block Oyu Tolgoi copper exports
record.detail: Members of a group called the Radical Reform Movement blocked the highway used by trucks carrying copper concentrate from Oyu Tolgoi to the Chinese border, demanding a larger revenue share; exports resumed after a brief disruption. No arrests or injuries were reported.
record.place: Oyu Tolgoi mine road, Khanbogd soum

record.title: Khaan Quest 2026 multinational exercise opens
record.detail: The 23rd Khaan Quest peacekeeping exercise opened at the Five Hills Training Area near Ulaanbaatar with more than 1,100 personnel from 18 countries, running to 3 July.

record.title: Orkhon, Khuder, Yuruu rivers above warning levels
record.detail: NEMA said water levels on the Orkhon, Khuder and Yuruu rivers rose 50-100 cm in a day, exceeding warning thresholds, and warned of further rises after cold rain and wet snow.

record.title: Unseasonal cold rain, wet snow; ground temps below -5C
record.detail: Cold rain and wet snowfall across Mongolia in late June pushed ground-level temperatures below -5C, according to NEMA as reported in coverage of its flood warning.

record.title: Cabinet backs new defence cooperation pact with South Korea
record.detail: The Cabinet supported a draft defence cooperation agreement with the Republic of Korea updating the 1999 accord, covering military visits, training and regular joint exercises.

record.title: Heat above +35C in west and Gobi; +40C in Gobi-Altai, Bayankhongor
record.detail: Forecasts reported by Montsame said temperatures would pass +35C in western and Gobi aimags and exceed +40C in southern Gobi-Altai and Bayankhongor, with UB at +28 to +30C.
record.attribution: Weather forecast as reported by Montsame

record.title: Under-18s banned from riding e-scooters, mopeds, e-bikes
record.detail: Amended traffic safety rules effective 1 July bar minors from light electric vehicles, with parents and rental operators liable; the trauma centre recorded 754 injuries in January-May, per the Ministry of Road and Transport.
record.attribution: Ministry of Road and Transport via Xinhua

record.title: Khalkh River exceeds danger level, severe flooding
record.detail: NAMEM and NEMA said the Khalkh River at Yalalt surpassed the danger level by 15 cm, causing severe flooding.
record.place: Khalkh River at Yalalt, Sumber soum

record.title: Multiple rivers 5-30 cm over flood levels
record.detail: Kharaa, Onon, Kherlen (incl. Baganuur), Khovd, Kharkhiraa and Tuul (Lun soum) rivers exceeded flood thresholds by 5-30 cm; further rises forecast for Tuul, Onon and Kherlen, per NAMEM and NEMA.
record.place: Kharaa, Onon, Kherlen, Khovd, Kharkhiraa, Tuul rivers

record.title: Israeli tourists attacked by axe-wielding man at campsite
record.detail: An intoxicated man shouting antisemitic slogans attacked a group of six Israeli tourists with an axe at a campsite in northern Mongolia; one man suffered a fractured jaw. Mongolian officials condemned the attack; the group declined to file a police complaint, per Hebrew media reports.
record.attribution: Hebrew media reports via The Times of Israel

record.title: Drowning and river rescues in north prompt water-safety warning
record.detail: NEMA reported four young men rescued by motorboat from the Selenge River in Bulgan province on 23 July, and a 22-year-old man drowned in the Kharaa River in Selenge province after a multi-day search; it urged people to use designated swimming areas.
record.attribution: National Emergency Management Agency, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Selenge, Chuluut, Baidrag rising; Tuul, Kharkhiraa above flood level
record.detail: Rivers rose 10-55 cm in a day with 10-20 cm more forecast on Selenge, Chuluut and Baidrag; Kharkhiraa and Tuul remained 5-10 cm above flood level, and the public was told to avoid riverbanks.
record.place: Selenge, Chuluut, Baidrag, Kharkhiraa, Tuul rivers
record.attribution: Flood warning as reported by Montsame

record.title: Mongolia-Russia joint border inspection 85% complete
record.detail: President Khurelsukh inspected work in Khuvsgul; the joint commission is replacing 1,620 markers on the 3,543 km border and 85% of engineering work is done, including renewed Marker No. 350.
record.agency: Joint Border Inspection Commission; Office of the President

record.title: State Emergency Commission reviews winter/dzud preparedness
record.detail: The State Emergency Commission, chaired by the Deputy PM, reviewed winter preparedness and backed amending the Disaster Protection Law to give local governments more financial authority in emergencies.

record.title: Flooding in Ulaanbaatar area: 1 dead, 189 displaced
record.detail: GDACS recorded authorities' reports of flooding in the Ulaanbaatar area on 1-3 Aug with one death and 189 people displaced (green alert).

record.title: Petrol purchases capped at 50,000 MNT under odd-even plate rule
record.detail: The energy minister limited AI-92 petrol sales to 50,000 MNT per vehicle with odd-even plate purchase days from 4 August, citing disrupted Russian supply after Russia suspended gasoline exports until 1 January 2027.
record.agency: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
record.attribution: Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Fuel supply disruption hits flights and road transport
record.detail: Tourism associations warned that a fuel supply shortage was disrupting domestic and international flights, road transport and tours at peak season, and sought an urgent inter-ministry meeting.

record.title: Mongolian herder held in Russia on espionage suspicion
record.detail: A Mongolian herder detained by Russian authorities while crossing the border in mid-February 2026 has been held for seven months on suspicion of espionage, AKIpress reported citing Udriin Sonin.

record.title: Illegal marmot hunting persists despite inspections
record.detail: Environment officials and the Ecological Police Division said marmot poaching shows little sign of declining despite relocation of 500-700 marmots a year; inspections are under way at habitats and checkpoints. No case figures were given.
record.attribution: Ministry of Environment and Climate Change; Ecological Police Division

record.title: 13 internationally wanted fugitives returned to Mongolia
record.detail: The National Police Agency said 13 citizens on the international wanted list were repatriated to Mongolia in July; details of their alleged offences were not published in the open excerpt.

record.title: UNEP, Mongolia launch USD 2m animal-disease project
record.detail: UNEP announced a USD 2 million joint project with the government to study the spread of infectious animal diseases and reduce outbreaks.
record.agency: UNEP; Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

record.title: Early September frost and wet snow forecast in mountains
record.detail: Meteorologists warned of sharp night-time drops, frost and early wet snow in mountainous regions in September, and herders were advised to prepare fodder; spring sowing had been delayed by wet snow.

record.title: Mongolia joins GlobE Network model agreement on corruption cases
record.detail: At a meeting in Vienna (25-28 August) the IAAC joined a model agreement among GlobE Network law-enforcement members for rapid, secure exchange of information and mutual assistance on transnational corruption cases.
record.attribution: Independent Authority Against Corruption, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Early influenza vaccination campaign, 500,000 doses
record.detail: The Health Ministry began free flu vaccination on 3 Sept with 500,000 doses at 600+ facilities for young children, pregnant women, over-65s and chronically ill, noting flu peaks in Jan-Feb.

record.title: Nationwide automatic air-quality monitoring network completed
record.detail: Automatic stations now cover Ulaanbaatar and all 21 aimag centres (PM2.5, PM10, SO2, NOx, O3, CO) under a USD 8.9 million Korea-backed project; data are public on agaar.gov.mn.
record.agency: Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

record.title: Mongolian, Chinese defence ministers agree to widen cooperation
record.detail: Defence Minister Damba Batlut met Chinese Defence Minister Dong Jun at the Beijing Xiangshan Forum and discussed expanding defence cooperation into new areas.

record.title: Officials warn fuel disruption could last two to three years
record.detail: A state secretary said Russian fuel supply disruptions could last 2-3 years due to refinery damage; the AI-92 shortage had run about 50 days, Ulaanbaatar stocks were critically low and four provinces faced delivery delays, while imports from South Korea and China were arranged.
record.agency: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
record.attribution: State Secretary B.Dashpurev, as reported by The UB Post

record.title: Mauritania moves to bolster strategic energy stocks amid Middle East tensions
record.detail: Headline only: the article body was not retrieved. Figures are as reported in the headline.
record.attribution: Headline only (article body not retrieved); figures and claims as attributed by Mauritanian government

record.title: Mauritania rescues 216 migrants in two operations; over 120 remain missing
record.detail: Headline only: the article body was not retrieved. Figures are as reported in the headline.

record.title: Amnesty urges charges dropped against El Hiblu 3
record.detail: Seven years on, Amnesty called for charges to be dropped against three young men who resisted a return to Libya (Amnesty).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Ten bodies recovered after migrant boat capsizes off Malta
record.detail: Italian rescuers recovered 10 bodies and saved about 48 people from a boat that reportedly left Libya (The Guardian).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: HPA: dengue, respiratory and gut illnesses up sharply in January
record.detail: The Health Protection Agency reported 647 dengue cases in January 2026 (424 a year earlier), plus 34,840 acute respiratory infections and 7,792 gastroenteritis cases; Vaavu atoll had the highest dengue rate.

record.title: Speedboat and supply vessel collide near Male'; vessel leaves scene
record.detail: Police said a speedboat collided with a supply vessel near Male' early on 1 June, injuring two crew; the supply vessel left without waiting and is being investigated separately.

record.title: Apartment fire in Male' sends 28 for treatment
record.detail: MNDF fire and rescue put out a fourth-floor residential fire on Lonuziyaaraiy Magu by midnight; 28 people were treated, with no deaths reported.

record.title: MET White Alert for northern and central atolls, rough seas
record.detail: The Maldives Meteorological Service issued a White Alert for HA. Atoll through Faafu Atoll, forecasting gusts to 40 mph, rough seas and heavy rain through the weekend.

record.title: Gas cylinder blast in Male' house injures four, 41 evacuated
record.detail: A gas cylinder exploded at a house in Male', burning four people (two in intensive care) and damaging an adjacent building; NDMA said 41 people were evacuated and given shelter.

record.title: Foreign Currency Act amendment ratified to curb black-market dollar trade
record.detail: President Muizzu ratified an amendment, effective 1 September, requiring businesses to convert 40% of foreign-currency earnings through MMA-licensed banks and limiting dollar trades to MMA-set rates; fines for individuals range from MVR 25,000 to MVR 1 million.

record.title: Heavy rain floods over 70 homes in Feydhoo, Addu City
record.detail: NDMA and MNDF responded after heavy rain flooded more than 70 houses in Feydhoo and two in Maradhoo; one household of eight was moved to a shelter, and more rain was forecast for southern and central atolls.

record.title: Two expatriates detained in black-market dollar trading crackdown
record.detail: Police and Immigration detained two Bangladeshi nationals on 12 and 14 September for unauthorised dollar trading; police said six expatriates held earlier had moved MVR 54.4 million and USD 1.6 million through their accounts over three years.

record.title: NDMA aids southern atolls after flood damage; 7 Feydhoo homes uninhabitable
record.detail: NDMA said about 80 houses flooded in Feydhoo, seven left uninhabitable, with sewerage and service disruption in Gaafu Alif, Gaafu Dhaalu, Fuvahmulah and Addu; it began cleaning, damage assessments and relocations.
record.prov: Gaafu Alif, Gaafu Dhaalu, Fuvahmulah, Addu

record.title: Coast Guard detains foreign vessel fishing illegally in EEZ
record.detail: MNDF Coast Guard said it intercepted a foreign fishing vessel with six people aboard about 124 nautical miles from K. Dhiffushi for unauthorised fishing in the EEZ; nationality not disclosed.

record.title: Power outage hits parts of Male' and Hulhumale'
record.detail: STELCO reported an electricity outage affecting Hulhumale' Phase 1 and the Henveiru, Machchangoalhi and Maafannu districts of Male'; the cause was under investigation.

record.title: Customs seize 3.34 kg of cannabis at Gan airport
record.detail: Maldives Customs said it found 3.34 kg of suspected cannabis in the luggage of two Indian men arriving from India at Gan International Airport; both were handed to police.

record.title: Police: 1,584 scams reported so far in 2026, over MVR 15m lost
record.detail: The Maldives Police Service Anti-Scam Centre reported 1,584 scam cases year-to-date with losses over MVR 15 million (MVR 6.6 million recovered); 2,803 accounts were frozen for 48 hours, 530 frozen for three more months by court order, and 53 suspects arrested. Fake online businesses (821) and currency-exchange fraud (240) led.

record.title: Flood damage to a key road hampers aid delivery in central Malawi
record.detail: Headline only: the article body was not retrieved. Figures are as reported in the headline.

record.detail: A magnitude 6.5 quake off the southwestern coast killed one person in Guerrero and one in Mexico City and damaged roads, buildings and hospitals (Reuters).

record.title: Army kills CJNG leader 'El Mencho' in military operation
record.detail: The Mexican army killed Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, head of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and a US most-wanted fugitive (AP via Yahoo).

record.title: Schools closed and residents told to stay in after cartel boss killed
record.detail: Violence hit Jalisco after the operation; schools were cancelled and people advised to stay inside, and several countries issued travel advisories (NDTV, Mint).

record.title: Flights resume to Puerto Vallarta after cartel violence
record.detail: Flights resumed after the US and Canada urged citizens to shelter in place during retaliatory cartel violence (Business Insider).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Probe into cartel fuel smuggling at seaports expanded
record.detail: Mexico expanded its investigation into fuel smuggling at sea ports by drug cartels (Reuters).

record.title: Massive security deployment planned for the World Cup
record.detail: Officials announced a large deployment of security forces for the World Cup after the February violence (NYT).

record.title: Two US officials who died in Mexico reportedly CIA personnel
record.detail: The Intercept reports two US officials who died in Mexico worked for the CIA, citing two sources; circumstances are not stated in the summary.

record.title: Salina Cruz refinery partly shut after fire
record.detail: Pemex's Salina Cruz refinery was partially shut after a fire, according to IIR Energy (Reuters).

record.title: Measles outbreak in Chihuahua traced to Texas
record.detail: The Health Ministry's epidemiology director said Mexico's outbreak stems from the Chihuahua outbreak that crossed from Texas (CNN).

record.title: Joint Ebola surveillance protocol for the World Cup
record.detail: Mexico, the US and Canada activated joint epidemiological surveillance for the World Cup because of an Ebola outbreak abroad (UPI).

record.title: Ministries investigate farm linked to US cyclospora outbreak
record.detail: Mexico's health and agriculture ministries are investigating a large foodborne cyclospora outbreak in the US linked to a Mexican farm (Reuters).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: US suspends Mexicali operations over 'potential threat'
record.detail: The US government suspended operations in Mexicali and advised Americans not to travel there (Newsweek).

record.title: Amended AML general rules published (Acuerdo 115/2026)
record.detail: Mexico amended the general rules under its anti-money-laundering law LFPIORPI (JD Supra).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Fireworks explosion kills at least 10 before festival display
record.detail: A pyrotechnics blast collapsed a church wall in Santa María Canchesdá, killing at least 10 and injuring 64 (MSN).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Hidden crypto farm suspected of cartel laundering raided in Puebla
record.detail: Investigators seized about 300 GPUs at a concealed mining site in Puebla suspected of electricity theft and cartel money laundering; no arrests reported (CoinCentral, Crowdfund Insider).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Hurricane Polo reaches Category 5 off the west coast
record.detail: Hurricane Polo strengthened from a tropical storm to Category 5 in under 24 hours before landfall (UPI).
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Heavy rain and waves batter Acapulco as Polo hovers offshore
record.detail: Mexico News Daily reports heavy rain and waves in Acapulco as Hurricane Polo stayed offshore.
record.attribution: Headline and search summary only (article body not retrieved)

record.title: Suspension bridge collapses under wedding guests in Kuala Krai
record.detail: More than 50 people fell into the Chatel Damai river when a worn suspension bridge at Lata Rek collapsed as wedding guests crossed; at least five were injured and none killed. PM Anwar ordered immediate replacement.

record.title: Wooden bridge collapse cuts off 4,500 villagers in Baram
record.detail: A wooden bridge in Miri division collapsed after nonstop rain, leaving over 4,500 residents of seven villages including Long Silat and Long Bee without a passable route; the Telang Usan penghulu reported no injuries.

record.title: Rompin village bridge collapses; seven rescued
record.detail: A bridge linking Kampung Selendang and Kampung Sungai Mok in Rompin collapsed around 08:00; police evacuated seven people including a heavily pregnant woman and the district JKR closed the road.

record.title: Flood evacuees rise in Sabah and Sarawak
record.detail: Disaster committee figures cited by Malay Mail put evacuees at 859 at 16:00: 619 in Sabah (Beaufort, Kota Kinabalu, Kota Belud), 213 in Miri, Sarawak, and 27 in Segamat, Johor.

record.title: Sabah and Sarawak floods displace 1,329
record.detail: NADMA said 1,329 people from 470 families were at 10 relief centres as of 16:00: 1,224 in Sabah's Beaufort and Tenom and 105 in Miri, Sarawak.

record.title: Severe continuous rain warning for Sarawak, west Sabah
record.detail: MetMalaysia issued a severe-level continuous heavy rain warning for Sarawak, western Sabah and Labuan until January 11, citing a monsoon surge, with strong wind and rough sea warnings for the South China Sea extended.

record.title: Sarawak floods worsen; 41 relief centres open
record.detail: Sarawak's disaster management committee reported 3,890 evacuees at 41 relief centres across seven divisions, with Serian district declared a disaster red zone; Sabah had 367 evacuees from Beaufort.
record.attribution: Sarawak JPBN figures via Malay Mail

record.title: Welding blast kills worker at Melaka recycling centre
record.detail: Melaka fire and rescue said an explosion during welding at a waste recycling centre in Bukit Rambai Industrial Park killed a 44-year-old man and injured a colleague; a hazmat team monitored for toxic gas.
record.attribution: Fire and rescue department via Malay Mail

record.title: Fire guts furniture factory in Sea Park, PJ
record.detail: Selangor fire and rescue deployed 34 personnel as a furniture factory on Jalan 20/1, Sea Park was engulfed, sending thick smoke across the area; no casualties were reported and the cause was under investigation.
record.attribution: Fire and rescue department via Malay Mail

record.title: Muda Dam falls to 20%; PBAPP activates contingency plan
record.detail: PBAPP said the Muda Dam dropped to 20% on February 20 from 84.6% on January 1 due to dry weather and irrigation releases, and activated its Sungai Muda Contingency Plan 2026 drawing on Mengkuang Dam.

record.title: M6.8 deep quake off Kudat, strongest in 11 years
record.detail: MetMalaysia said a magnitude 6.8 quake struck about 49km west of Kudat at 00:57 at a depth of 678km, the strongest to hit Malaysia in 11 years; only mild tremors were felt, with no tsunami threat or damage reported.

record.title: Peat fire at Kuala Tatau needs aerial water bombing
record.detail: Bomba said a peat fire of about 5 hectares at Kuala Tatau Serupai burned for four days; a Mi-171 helicopter from the Miri air unit made 15 water-bombing runs by March 26.

record.title: MetMalaysia: heatwave to last until June
record.detail: MetMalaysia's director-general said temperatures could reach 37-38C in northern states, peaking mid-March to mid-April; Level 1 alerts covered 17 peninsular areas and Level 2 heatwave warnings three areas.

record.title: Level 2 heatwave in Perlis, Kedah and Hulu Perak
record.detail: MetMalaysia placed seven areas at Level 2 heatwave (37-40C for three days), including Perlis, Kota Setar, Pokok Sena, Pendang, Sik, Baling and Hulu Perak, with 13 more at Level 1 alert.

record.title: Kelana Jaya LRT slowdown after train fault
record.detail: Rapid KL said a train was withdrawn and run manually between KL Sentral and Masjid Jamek, slowing services; FMT noted a power outage and a fallen branch on the line earlier that week and that Prasarana had submitted a recovery plan to Cabinet.

record.title: Two killed in DUKE chain crash
record.detail: KL traffic police said a broken-down lorry at KM10.4 of the DUKE between Ayer Panas toll and Ampang triggered a chain collision involving three lorries and a pickup, killing two and injuring three.
record.agency: Kuala Lumpur Police Traffic Investigation Division

record.title: Festive road deaths up 17% over CNY and Aidilfitri
record.detail: IGP Khalid Ismail said Ops Selamat 25 and 26 recorded 90 road deaths (vs 77) and 9,934 accidents, with 144,726 summonses issued.

record.title: MACC freezes 133 accounts worth RM160m in false import declaration probe
record.detail: MACC's Operation Celio remanded a company owner, searched 14 sites and froze 133 bank accounts holding about RM160 million under the MACC Act and AMLA, alleging a syndicate of importers and forwarders underdeclared goods since 2020, costing about RM1.5 billion in duties.

record.title: Thousands rally at Dataran Merdeka over anti-graft chief
record.detail: Thousands gathered in Kuala Lumpur to demand a Royal Commission of Inquiry into allegations against outgoing MACC chief Azam Baki; police deployed riot gear and armoured vehicles and said they would call in organisers over a firecracker incident.
record.attribution: Police and participants via The Edge (Bloomberg)

record.title: Widespread CelcomDigi network disruption
record.detail: Users reported a widespread CelcomDigi outage affecting mobile data, SMS, navigation apps and cashless payments; FMT said the company had not yet commented and some users called on MCMC to investigate.

record.title: Sarawak's fourth rabies death of 2026
record.detail: Sarawak health department said a 63-year-old Bintulu man bitten by a puppy in February died of rabies, the state's fourth death this year and 87th of 94 human cases since the 2017 outbreak declaration.

record.title: Bukit Aman: 2,251 arrested in four anti-scam operations since January
record.detail: CCID director Rusdi Mohd Isa said Ops Taring (430 arrests, 270 of them foreigners), Ops Belatuk (403, targeting mule accounts in job and e-commerce scams), Ops Frontier (1,372) and Ops Cenderahati (46) led to 2,251 arrests from January to early May.

record.title: Flash floods across Klang Valley
record.detail: Thunderstorms flooded Kuchai Link (fully closed), parts of the NPE near Bangsar, Desa Tun Razak and a Petaling Jaya food court where water was about 1.2m deep; Selangor fire and rescue said no evacuation was needed.
record.attribution: Fire and rescue department via FMT

record.title: 46 raids bust international scam ring; 187 held, RM57.68m seized
record.detail: The Inspector-General of Police said raids on 6-7 May across the Klang Valley and beyond arrested 187 suspects, 129 of them Chinese nationals, over fake investment, Japanese-police impersonation and romance scams, seizing properties, cars and luxury goods worth RM57.68 million.

record.title: Drought in Kedah rice bowl prompts cloud seeding
record.detail: PM Anwar Ibrahim announced cloud seeding as the Muda Agricultural Development Authority's main reservoir was reported at about 8% capacity, delaying planting in Malaysia's main rice region.
record.agency: Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security / MADA

record.title: Migrant boat capsizes off Pangkor; bodies recovered
record.detail: Perak MMEA said a boat believed carrying 37 Indonesians from Kisaran capsized about 8.2nm northwest of Pulau Pangkor; 23 were rescued and four bodies recovered, with 10 still missing.

record.title: Southwest Monsoon begins, drier conditions to September
record.detail: MetMalaysia said the Southwest Monsoon would run from May 14 to September with fewer rainy days, early-morning squall lines on the west coast, and a risk of local and transboundary haze from July to September.

record.title: Pipe burst in Butterworth cuts Penang supply
record.detail: PBAPP said a 135cm pipeline on Jalan Raja Uda burst, reportedly due to a third-party contractor, disrupting supply across North Seberang Perai and parts of Southwest Penang Island; the same main burst on May 17.

record.title: 23 road deaths on first day of Aidiladha
record.detail: PDRM's traffic department (JSPT) recorded 1,225 accidents and 23 deaths nationwide on May 27, up from 15 deaths the day before.
record.agency: PDRM Traffic Investigation and Enforcement Department (JSPT)

record.title: Sarawak dams hit drought emergency levels
record.detail: Sarawak's disaster committee said Batang Ai and Bakun dams were at Drought Emergency Level 1 and Murum at drought-event status, and launched cloud seeding with NADMA; it also flagged Kuala Baram peatland as high fire risk.

record.title: 38,842 dengue cases in first half; DENV-3 dominant
record.detail: Figures reported by The Star put dengue cases at 38,842 from Jan 4 to Jun 27, led by Selangor (17,701), Kuala Lumpur (7,191) and Johor (4,591), with DENV-3 now the dominant serotype.

record.title: MACC freezes 14 accounts, seizes RM1.4m in immigration syndicate probe
record.detail: MACC Chief Commissioner Abd Halim Aman said 38 people including enforcement officers and civil servants were arrested midweek over a syndicate abusing social visit passes for foreign workers; 14 accounts holding about RM1.1 million were frozen and RM1.4 million in assets seized in Putrajaya, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Melaka.

record.title: Home Ministry: online scams cost RM5.37b from 2024 to May 2026
record.detail: A Home Ministry parliamentary reply put online scam losses at RM5.37 billion from 2024 to May 2026, with fake investment schemes (RM2.68 billion), telecom scams (RM1.54 billion) and e-financial crime making up over 90%.

record.title: Landslide half-blocks Tapah-Cameron Highlands road
record.detail: Perak fire and rescue said heavy rain triggered a landslide near Batu 25, about 7km from Ringlet, blocking half the road with rocks and trees; it was cleared by 5.22:00 with no casualties.
record.attribution: Fire and rescue department via The Star

record.title: Sabah CM: no kidnap-for-ransom in ESSZone since 2020
record.detail: At the ESSZone joint committee meeting co-chaired with Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail, Sabah Chief Minister Hajiji Noor said there had been no kidnap-for-ransom cases since January 2020 and security was under control; he urged foreign missions to review travel advisories.
record.attribution: Sabah Chief Minister via The Star

record.title: 30-hectare peat fire in Betong; Lundu forest fire controlled
record.detail: Sarawak fire and rescue reported a 30-hectare peatland fire at Jalan Bungin, Betong with no nearby water source, and a nearly 2-hectare fire in Samunsam Forest Reserve, Lundu, controlled with 13 water-bombing flights.

record.title: Selangor police shut five scam call centres run from homes; 40 held
record.detail: Selangor police chief Shazeli Kahar said raids from 18 to 25 August in Sungai Buloh, Bukit Rimau, Kajang and Subang Jaya arrested 40 people, 37 of them foreigners, running love scams, foreign-police impersonation and video-subscription scams from residential premises.

record.title: Hazardous haze in Serian and Samarahan
record.detail: APIMS readings at 09:00 showed 17 areas unhealthy to hazardous, led by Serian (API 374) and Samarahan (306); Kuching reached 295 and Kuala Lumpur 153.

record.title: Four killed in 11-vehicle pile-up on LPT1
record.detail: Pahang fire and rescue said an express bus hit a tanker at KM110.4 of the East Coast Expressway near Lanchang, triggering an 11-vehicle pile-up that killed four and injured four; the 30 bus passengers were unhurt.
record.attribution: Fire and rescue department via The Vibes

record.title: Penang ferry collides with another vessel
record.detail: A Penang ferry heading to Butterworth collided with another vessel at 20:35, toppling motorcycles on board; passengers reported minor injuries and the ferry docked safely.

record.title: Haze cancels AirBorneo flights at Kuching
record.detail: Kuching International Airport said two AirBorneo flights (to Mukah and Tanjung Manis) were cancelled due to haze, while runway visibility stayed at 2,000m, above the 800m minimum.

record.title: NSRC seized RM7.94m in scam proceeds Jan-July, returned RM5.16m
record.detail: Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution Ismail said the National Scam Response Centre seized RM7.94 million in scam proceeds from January to July 2026 and returned RM5.16 million (65%) to victims; 746 Malaysians had fallen for fraudulent overseas job offers by late August.

record.title: Main pipe leak cuts water to 34,000 accounts in Kelantan
record.detail: Air Kelantan said a leak in a 1,100mm pipe at Pulai Chondong disrupted supply to about 34,000 accounts in Machang, southern Kota Bharu and Pasir Puteh; 24 tankers supplied hospitals and schools.

record.title: 39 areas at unhealthy API as haze spreads
record.detail: APIMS showed 39 areas with unhealthy API at 16:00, highest at Johan Setia, Selangor (188), with Cheras 177 and Nilai 176; a cloud seeding operation was reported to begin in the Klang Valley.

record.title: Exceptionally heavy rain floods Ampang area of KL
record.detail: KL Mayor Fadlun Mak Ujud said Lembah Keramat recorded 155.5mm of rain, about five times the usual, causing flash floods in Ampang, Taman U-Thant and Jalan Ampang.

record.title: Thunderstorm warning for KL, Labuan and nine states
record.detail: MetMalaysia warned of thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds until 21:00 across Kuala Lumpur, Labuan and districts in Perak, Kelantan, Terengganu, Pahang, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan, Johor, Sarawak and Sabah.

record.title: Cloud seeding for low dams in Johor, Melaka, N. Sembilan
record.detail: NADMA, MetMalaysia and the natural resources ministry began a four-day cloud-seeding operation to raise dam levels and secure water supply, also as a haze mitigation measure.

record.title: Økokrim case: thousands of U.S. silver coins recovered, three sentenced
